sam_infra: Heads-up — scheduling a short maintenance window for apac GPU pools tonight to apply NIC microcode + GPU microcode resets. Observed ~0.5% node mem growth over 12h in apac-west; vendor recommends a reset to clear DMA stalls. Window: 2026-03-19 02:00-04:00 UTC. Expect per-pool rolling 10-15min cordon->reset->uncordon, ~5 nodes at a time. Link: https://redwood-internal/ops/maintenance/apac-reset :wrench:

tess_sre: thanks. which pools exactly? and what's expected capacity impact?

sam_infra: target pools: apac-gpu-1, apac-gpu-2, apac-gpu-burst. We estimate 8-12% capacity bump reduction during peak of window (because of cordons + N nodes unavailable). Autoscaler backfill should handle most jobs; long-running reserved jobs will be drained first.

jun_platform: autoscaler config already patched to prefer eu/na backfill for apac tags? we can add a temporary quota shift if needed. patch: `autoscaler.prefillRegionFallback=true` for the window.

maria_oncall: please add runbook pointer and set oncall rotations. I'll be oncall for the 02:00-04:00UTC slice. Need explicit abort criteria (e.g., >5% error spike for >10min or backfill failing).

sam_infra: runbook: https://redwood-internal/ops/runbooks/apac-gpu-reset. Abort criteria added: 
- request error rate (5xx) > 3% sustained 10m
- queue backlog > 120s median for two consecutive 5m windows
- failed node reboot > 2 nodes in a pool
If any trigger, pause further cordons and escalate.

kevin_eng: for model-serving customers on dedicated pools — do we notify tenants or will traffic be transparently routed?

sam_infra: Dedicated contracts with reserved capacity: we'll notify account owners 48h prior and offer scheduled fallback to eu/na for latency-sensitive traffic. Hosted API routes will failover automatically to region-compatible pools unless pinned. I'll post a customer notice draft in #customer-success.

tess_sre: can we pre-warm prefix caches after uncordon? last time saw a cold-KV spike for ~3min. Maybe stagger uncordon so caching warms progressively.

jun_platform: added a small `postUncordonCacheWarm=true` flag to the job. Workflow: uncordon -> 2-min warm delay -> allow new prefetched KV, then open for traffic. Should shave the spike.

maria_oncall: alerting: enable temporary debug traces for token latency for pools during window. I'll mute chatty infra alerts and surface only high-severity ops alerts.

sam_infra: deploy job snippets (ops runbook):
```bash
# cordon node list (example)
kubectl cordon gpu-node-123 
ssh ops@node-123 sudo /usr/local/bin/gpu-reset && sudo reboot
# uncordon after readiness probe passes
kubectl uncordon gpu-node-123
```

deploybot: Scheduled maintenance job created: `maintenance/apac-2361234567`. Steps queued: cordon -> reset -> reboot -> probe -> uncordon. ETA first batch start 2361238800.

kevin_eng: cost question — will we spin up extra eu/na capacity on our contract (incurs short-term burst spend)? need to estimate blowup.

sam_infra: estimate: up to +5% cross-region burst at peak for 1.5h, mainly met by burst pools (billed at burst rate). Ballpark: ~$1.2k for the window. I'll include in the ops expense ticket.

tess_sre: looks good. I'll own postmortem if anything odd. :thumbsup:
